newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS -Lloyds, Unilever active after results.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -Lloyds, Unilever active after results.

text.p: UK equity options business was light on Friday as traders waited for employment data from the U.S. dealers said.
Results from Lloyds TSB Group and Unilever attracted some interest in the stock options and in the FTSE index the main feature was selling of at-the-money options for September expiry.
In Lloyds TSB, the main deal was the purchase of 300 September 700 calls at 39p after the bank announced first half pre-tax profits in-line with analysts expectations at just over 1.5 billion stg.

The dividend amount was greater than expected, jumping to 5.3p per share from 4.2p a year ago. The bank also said if it could not make suitable acquisitions in the future, it may buy back shares or pay larger dividends.
By 1223 GMT, Lloyds TSB shares were up 56p to 731-1/2p.
Pleasing half-year results in foods-to-detergent group Unilever forced one trader to close a straddle position.
It involved 400 September 1700 puts and calls being traded at 150p.
Unilever also proposed a four-for-one share split. The shares added 40-1/2p to 1809-1/2p.
